title: Battle of Scheveningen
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Scheveningen", at revision 1382282893, opens: "The Battle of Scheveningen was the final naval battle of the First Anglo-Dutch War. It took place on 31 July 1653 between the fleets of the Commonwealth of England and the Dutch Republic. The Dutch fleet suffered heavy losses." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q575737, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1653 final naval battle of the First Anglo-Dutch War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
